description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendments: Indibedda, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520203
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with the amendment of a land title registration for specific parcels of land (No. 405 and 406) in Colombo District. It involves correcting owner name and address details in the land registry, which falls under land and property-related matters. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" and specifically references the "REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT," confirming its focus on land administration rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
